subject: SagePath production quality regression — compensation and contract path
messages:
From: Daniel Kwan <daniel.k@sagepath.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Li <maya.li@sagepath.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production regressions impacting inference latency and errors — immediate ask

Hi Connor,

Quick note from the ops desk — since ~03:00 UTC last night we've seen a sustained 3x increase in P95 latency for our /generate route and a spike in 5xx errors that correlates to several large batch requests. Our customers are seeing timeouts in the UI and our CS team is fielding escalations.

I've attached the svc-metrics-june29.csv and a short log snippet; you'll see the error-rate uptick starts around 02:45 UTC. Can Redwood confirm root cause and provide an initial commercial remedy: SLA credit estimate and a timeline for mitigation? We also need confirmation this won't recur next week during our peak window.

We're evaluating our renewal in August so this is urgent.

Thanks,
Daniel
Ops Lead, SagePath
attachments: svc-metrics-june29.csv, log-snippet.txt
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kwan <daniel.k@sagepath.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production regressions impacting inference latency and errors — immediate ask

Daniel — thanks for the data and the heads up. I'm escalating internally and looping in Marcus (AE) and Laura (CS/ops) so we can coordinate a remediation + commercial response.

Short answers: we're seeing the same spike on our side and have kicked an emergency job to clear stale KV cache growth on the affected GPU pool. Laura will share a mitigation timeline in the next update. Marcus and I will scope an initial credit calculation under your SLA.

I appreciate the urgency — we'll be explicit about next steps and a proposed credit by EOD.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0142
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kwan <daniel.k@sagepath.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production regressions impacting inference latency and errors — immediate ask

On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 09:30 AM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Daniel — thanks for the data and the heads up. I'm escalating internally ...

Daniel, Connor — quick technical update: root cause appears to be a combination of two factors: a KV-cache fragmentation bug that increases memory pressure for long-lived sessions, and a scheduling regression in the 2.7.3 runtime that degrades continuous-batching efficiency for mixed-sequence workloads.

What we've done:
- Restarted the affected pod pool and flushed prefix caches (mitigates immediately).
- Rolled a hotfix to the scheduling parameter set to avoid pathological batching for the next 48 hours.
- Created a telemetry alert to stop auto-scaling into the problematic GPU type during your peak window.

Next actions (ETA):
- Short-term: monitoring and rollback guard in place — expect stable P95 within 1 hour of this message.
- Medium-term: a runtime patch (non-disruptive) scheduled for 2027-07-02 02:00 UTC.
- Postmortem: full RCA and code patch by 2027-07-05.

I'll attach the initial metrics snapshot and the proposed amendment language for credits; Connor/Marcus, please see attached: SLA-claim-form-sagepath.pdf and proposed-amendment-v1.docx.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
attachments: SLA-claim-form-sagepath.pdf, proposed-amendment-v1.docx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kwan <daniel.k@sagepath.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production regressions impacting inference latency and errors — initial credit estimate

Daniel — appreciate the patience. Based on the affected window in your metrics and the SLA terms (P95 latency & availability), our preliminary commercial offer is:

- A one-time credit equal to 35% of June's invoice for the affected routes, applied as account credit on your July billing cycle.
- A commitment to a targeted SLO improvement plan and a contract amendment that adds an explicit throughput clause and accelerated remediation SLAs for the dedicated pool you're on.

We're proposing the attached amendment (proposed-amendment-v1.docx) which narrows the SLA window and defines credit calculation steps. Rishi — please advise if the language is approvable for execution or if legal needs edits before we send this to SagePath.

Next steps I suggest: Marcus/Connor to run this by Daniel and schedule an exec-level call (30 minutes) with SagePath leadership to sign the amendment or propose edits.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production regressions impacting inference latency and errors — legal on amendment

Marcus — reviewed the draft amendment. Key points:
- The proposed credit formula is acceptable but we should add a 12-month cap on aggregate credits for severe outages to limit exposure.
- Add a clause that allows Redwood to open a billing reconciliation if discrete third-party infra issues are identified.
- Require DocuSign execution and a 30-day review period for any retroactive claim over one invoice.

I'll attach the redline and can produce a clean doc for signature once we agree to the commercial numbers. Connor/Marcus — I'll join the exec call if you want legal present.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: amendment-redline-v1.pdf
From: Daniel Kwan <daniel.k@sagepath.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Li <maya.li@sagepath.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production regressions impacting inference latency and errors — acceptance of path forward

Connor / Marcus — thanks for the rapid handling and transparency. The short-term mitigation worked and our P95 numbers are back within threshold. We appreciate the initial 35% credit offer and want to move forward with the amendment pending the legal redline.

Two asks before signing: please add a visible operational contact during SLA events (single phone/pager) and confirm the DocuSign link once Rishi publishes the redline clean copy. We'll aim to execute the amendment within 10 business days.

I'll complete and return the SLA-claim-form-sagepath.pdf for your records today.

Best,
Daniel
Ops Lead, SagePath
attachments: SLA-claim-form-sagepath.pdf
